faq.title: FAQ
faq.whatIsA: Aistroyka is an AI-powered construction intelligence platform: project management, tasks, daily reports, photo evidence, and AI analytics in one place.
faq.whoIsForA: Developers, general contractors, contractors, project managers, and field teams. Any role that needs visibility, control, or reporting on construction.
faq.howAiA: AI analyzes site photos for progress, deviations, and risks. Results are suggestions; decisions stay with managers (human-in-the-loop).
faq.mobileA: Yes. Manager and worker apps for field reporting, tasks, and photo evidence. Fast workflows and offline-friendly scenarios.
faq.pricingA: We offer Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans. Contact us for a quote or book a demo for a tailored proposal.
